title: Yellow Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb tagine with meringue nests, perfect for a midnight craving, featuring anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, cooked in a comal vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the comal vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the turmeric, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
While the tagine is cooking, prepare the meringue nests according to the package instructions or your homemade recipe.
To serve, place a meringue nest on each plate and spoon the lamb tagine over the top.
